U000.function: Fires on the final piece of a multi-token word or number (name, place, unit, abbreviation) where the word is just completed, e.g. yard, ton, mm, Fair, V. Completion of a proper-noun or measurement span.

U001.function: Digit inside a multi-digit number that is a statistic or measurement (points, shots, percentages, feet), typically the second digit after a leading digit; also 'being'/'franchise' in 'first time in franchise history' contexts.

U002.function: First fragment of a rare or long word that is split into pieces and continues in the next token (embro-iled, omin-ous, epile-ptic, Hodg-kin, Jacqu-eline). Predicts a suffix continuation.

U003.function: Digit or separator within a birth/death date year, in a biographical opening like (born August 2, 1964) or (28 June 1895 – 16 February 1973).

U004.function: Digit within a large number following a total, currency, or sales count (Total 10,247; US $56 million; sold 152,500 units; £4000), often right after a comma-formatted or dollar-sign number start.

U005.function: Mixed: last digit of a year, closing parenthesis after a measurement, and contrastive or additive function words (latter, otherwise, not only). Positions where a clause or span is about to close or continue to a paired element.

U006.function: Function word that introduces an explanation, definition, or description of a preceding item: 'meaning [that]', 'comes from [its]', 'known [for]', 'and', 'the', period after a note. Expects an elaborating phrase next, typically etymology or definition.

U007.function: Punctuation or short token that attaches onto a name or phrase: possessive apostrophe after a name (Fernandez 's, father 's), dashes, slashes, and ending pieces of a name or species (mask-ray). Marks a join point before a continuation.

U008.function: Preposition or participle that begins an attached modifying phrase after a comma or noun: 'coupled with', 'consisting of', 'along with', 'by authority of', 'at the behest'. Expects a following complement.

U009.function: Middle or end fragment of a South Asian (Bollywood) person name split into tokens: Nadiadwala, Bhatt, Thakur, Madhuri, Chakravarthy, Deol, Rani. Name-internal pieces in a film-cast context.

U010.function: Digit inside a numeric quantity in a measurement or sales figure (inches/mm, units sold 'just over 152'), plus 'over' before a number. Number-with-unit context.

U011.function: Token inside a fixed idiom or superlative frame needing completion: 'one [of] the', 'Got to [Be] a Way', 'either', 'generally', year last digit. Positions that predict a specific common continuation.

U012.function: First digit (or the space) right after an opening parenthesis in a metric conversion, e.g. 7 inches ( [1]80 mm ), 13 knots ( [2]4 km/h). Start of the converted value.

U013.function: Final digit of a four-digit year in a dated list or biography (1964, 1578, 1923, 1911, 1990), especially within parentheses or after 'In'/'from'. Year-ending digit.

U014.function: Result-clause or degree construction: after 'so ... / such ... / enough', the token that introduces the consequence (that, to, it, he, require, allow). Tracks the so...that / enough...to pattern.

U015.function: Mixed closing or joining tokens: closing paren after list item labels, ellipsis end, apostrophe in titles (Child 's), word pieces of nouns in lists (Customs, Posts, gill). No single function.

U016.function: Noun at the end of a list or noun phrase about military supplies, materiel and institutions (ammunition, cartridges, weapons, equipment, coal, library). Concrete plural material or goods noun closing an enumeration.

U017.function: Digit within a year, usually the second or third digit (18-61, 19-11, 20-09, 15-72) after a century start. Mid-year digit prediction.

U018.function: Past-tense auxiliary or verb or determiner in a sentence stating a historical fact about a building, organization or species (was, were, had, belonged, included, home to, the first). Verb slot of a historical-description sentence.

U019.function: Token in a negated change/degree construction ('did not change [the] fortunes', 'not in any technical sense', 'not badly damaged') and the opening parenthesis or first digit of a metric conversion. Two loose themes: negation scope and unit conversion.
